fields.name: contractId
fields.short: The unique identifier of the contract associated with this change.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The date and time when the contract change was created, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: deltaLineItems
fields.short: An array of line items that represent the difference resulting from the contract change.

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.short: The date when the contract change becomes effective, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier for the contract change.

fields.name: lineItemChanges
fields.short: An array of changes to line items associated with the contract change.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the contract change.

fields.name: proposedLineItems
fields.short: An array of line items that are proposed as part of the contract change.

fields.name: prorating
fields.short: A boolean indicating whether the contract change involves prorating.

fields.name: quoteId
fields.short: The unique identifier of the quote associated with this contract change.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The current status of the contract change.

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of contract change.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The date and time when the contract change was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: feeValue
fields.short: The numerical value of the fee, indicating the amount to be charged.

fields.name: feeValueType
fields.short: The type of the fee value, represented as a string, which defines how the fee value is interpreted (e.g., as a percentage or a fixed amount).

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier for this checkout fee configuration.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the checkout fee, used for identification and display purposes.

fields.name: canPayout
fields.short: A boolean indicating whether the account is capable of making payouts.

fields.name: canTransact
fields.short: A boolean indicating whether the account is capable of processing transactions.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The date and time when the payment account was created, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: eligibleProcessorTypes
fields.short: An array of processor types that the account is eligible to use.

fields.name: enrollmentState
fields.short: The current enrollment state of the payment account.

fields.name: hasTransacted
fields.short: A boolean indicating whether the account has ever processed a transaction.

fields.name: id
